skills.description_en: A professional bid writing assistant for procurement projects across China's provinces, cities, districts and counties. Integrates tender analysis, needs assessment, qualification and rejection-risk checks, scoring analysis, response strategy, technical/commercial/price proposal drafting, editable Word generation and document review. Supports construction, goods, services and training bids, with similarity checks limited to available materials. Local and industry rules require project-specific verification. Does not replace a dedicated plagiarism engine, platform signing or submission, or legal dispute handling.

skills.name: bidding-compliance-advisor
skills.description_zh: 投标人侧投标文件合规检查技能：对照招标文件系统核查格式、资质、签字盖章、密封、份数、实质性响应，输出可打印打勾的四级结构化清单（废标/资质/格式/时间）与倒计时冲刺流程，提前发现废标风险；含输入预检、必查盲区校验、判定标尺、多轮状态管理与内置法条/案例库离线兜底。支撑招标文件合法性审查、法条问答、违规识别、异议投诉辅助。
skills.description_en: Bidder-side bid document compliance checker: systematically verify format, qualifications, signatures/seals, sealing, copies, and substantive response against the tender document, and output a printable four-tier checklist (rejection / qualification / format / timeline) with a countdown sprint flow to catch rejection risks early. Includes input pre-check, mandatory blind-spot validation, judgment rubrics, multi-turn state management, and an offline built-in legal/case library. Supports tender document legality review, legal Q&A, violation identification, and objection/complaint assistance.

skills.name: bidding-doc-parser
skills.description_zh: 从招标文件或招标工程量清单（Word/PDF）中自动提取分部分项工程量清单，识别项目编码、项目名称、项目特征、计量单位、工程量、综合单价、合价，输出结构化 Excel 表格，可直接作为工程造价审核技能的输入做清单对比。
skills.description_en: Extract the bill of quantities from a bidding document or tender BOQ (Word/PDF), recognizing item code, name, feature, unit, quantity, unit price, and total price, and output a structured Excel sheet ready for cost-audit comparison.

skills.name: biganzi-engine
skills.description_zh: 体制内公文写作系统，装上就能用。撰写或修改公文材料（通知、请示、报告、批复、函、讲话稿、工作总结、工作方案、调研报告、主持词、述职报告、对照检查材料、理论文章、政务信息、企业简介、党代会报告、决议、会议议题表等）时使用，也用于改写初稿、去AI味、压缩套话、校对把关。内置30文种决策表、24文种骨架库（三色比例＋六条铁律）、六层句法（动宾句/主谓句、三动一果、成句四要素、段落六大逻辑、标题同构/一词破题、天线地气贯通）、第一读者与文风切换、事实七问、语气五级、去AI味七查、校对三层处置、六维质量评分与GB/T 9704格式规范；零配置即可开写，配置后可按本单位口径、领导偏好、本地范文自建弹药库与验收题库。
skills.description_en: Self-evolving official document writing system for Chinese government agencies, public institutions and SOEs. Use when writing or revising gongwen documents: notices, requests for instructions, reports, official replies, letters, speeches, work summaries, work plans, research reports, MC scripts, debriefing reports, self-criticism materials, theoretical articles, government information briefs, entity introductions, party congress reports, resolutions, meeting agendas. Also for rewriting drafts, removing AI tone, compressing boilerplate, and proofreading. Built-in 30-document-type decision table, 24-type structural skeleton library with three-color ratio and six laws, six-layer syntax, first-reader tone switching, fact seven questions, tone five-level scale, de-AI review checklist, three-tier proofreading, six-dimension scoring and GB/T 9704 formatting. Works with zero configuration; local configuration and self-built corpus make it fit your organization.

skills.name: bilibili-video-studio
skills.description_zh: B站视频全解析：URL 直达，转文字/分析总结/爆款拆解六维评分/转脚本/脚本生成/提示词反推/PPT提取/备考笔记，八大场景全覆盖。
skills.description_en: Turn a Bilibili video link into a transcript, a content summary, a viral-structure breakdown with six-axis scoring, a shot-by-shot script, a rewritten original script, a generation prompt, extracted slide text, or study notes. Eight scenes, one link.

skills.name: bilibili-video-summary
skills.description_zh: 总结 B站视频内容，提取结构化要点并逐条核查事实。支持单视频与 UP 主频道批量总结。覆盖知识教程、财经交易、健康医学科普、政策法规解读、影视书籍解读、个人成长与观点、AI 应用等十余类题材，每类有专门的必查项与核查规范。
skills.description_en: Summarize Bilibili videos and extract structured key points with per-claim fact-checking. Supports single-video and UP主 channel batch summaries. Covers tutorials, finance/trading, health & medical science, policy interpretation, film/book analysis, personal growth, AI applications and more, each with its own mandatory checks.

skills.name: blender-operation
skills.description_zh: 通过 BlenderMCP 驱动本机 Blender，完成 3D 建模、材质灯光、相机设置、渲染出图与 GLB/OBJ/STL 导入导出；内置跨机器环境自动探测、零依赖自检（--self-test）与演示产物生成（--demo），未安装 Blender 的机器上也能验证客户端可用性并生成可运行的建模脚本。附带可自我迭代的操作技能收录机制：每次实战沉淀的新操作、新套路、新技巧自动收录进技能库，使技能随使用者个性化需求不断成长。当用户要求在 Blender 中创建/修改 3D 模型、搭建场景、渲染图片、导出模型或进行任何 Blender 自动化操作时使用。
skills.description_en: Drives the local Blender via BlenderMCP to do 3D modeling, materials & lighting, camera setup, rendering, and GLB/OBJ/STL import/export; built-in cross-machine environment auto-detection, zero-dependency self-test (--self-test) and demo generation (--demo), so the client and runnable modeling scripts work even on machines without Blender installed. A self-evolving operation collection mechanism captures new operations, workflows and techniques into the skill library during real tasks. Use when the user asks to create/modify 3D models, build scenes, render images, export models in Blender, or perform any Blender automation.

skills.name: blogger-distiller
skills.description_zh: 把博主的文章蒸馏成一个写作分身。给他 3 篇以上文章，产出风格提示词和可安装的分身技能——不只写得像，想得也像。内置 14 种写作公式与输出前强制执行的双重复检。
skills.description_en: Distill a blogger's articles into a writing clone that thinks like them, not just writes like them. Feed it 3+ articles, get a reusable style prompt plus an installable sub-skill with 14 writing formulas and a mandatory dual-check before output.

skills.description_en: Monitor blogs and RSS feeds for updates

skills.name: book-deconstruction
skills.description_zh: 书籍拆解。按「解构-推演-洞察-重构」四阶段十二个动作深度拆解一本书——一句话核心主张、五个思维模型、三章必读、逐章论点与论据溯源、可被反驳处、前沿争论、十问、复述考官检验、框架思维导图，最终合并为 Word 报告。支持古籍经典、现代学术、商业畅销、叙事类、技术教材五类书的分流策略。
skills.description_en: Deep-deconstruct a book into reusable output - one-sentence core thesis, five mental models, three must-read chapters, chapter-by-chapter arguments with source citations, rebuttable points, frontier debates, ten probing questions, a recall-and-examine drill, and a framework mindmap, delivered as a Word report. Handles classics, academic works, business bestsellers, narratives, and technical textbooks with genre-specific strategies.

skills.name: book-deconstructor
skills.description_zh: 拆书助手——输入一本书名，输出深度拆解稿+小红书配文+7张文生图提示词。拆解稿让你「不读书也有读过的感觉」；小红书配文（标题≤20字+4段简短正文+引导读者索要完整拆书稿的CTA+话题标签）直接复制粘贴就能发，是引流工具而非内容全集；7张Gemini文生图提示词（1封面+6金句）可以喂给Gemini生成配图。触发词：「拆书」「拆解这本书」「帮我拆一下」「这本书怎么样」「值不值得读」「讲一下这本书」「XX这本书讲了什么」。
skills.description_en: Book Deconstructor — give it a book title and it returns a deep-dive breakdown, a Xiaohongshu (RED) post caption, and 7 Gemini text-to-image prompts. The breakdown gives you the feeling of having read the book without actually reading it; the Xiaohongshu caption (title within 20 characters + four short body paragraphs + a CTA inviting readers to ask for the full breakdown + hashtags) is copy-paste ready and works as a lead magnet rather than the complete content; the 7 prompts (1 cover + 6 quote cards) can be fed to Gemini one by one to generate the artwork. Built for Chinese book titles and Chinese social platforms. Triggers: "拆书", "拆解这本书", "帮我拆一下", "这本书怎么样", "值不值得读", "讲一下这本书", "XX这本书讲了什么".

skills.name: book-distillation
skills.description_zh: 书籍蒸馏技能，是一台把整本书压缩成可复用资产的高保真蒸馏引擎。输入书名或原文，输出分层摘要、全书骨架、思维模型、行动方法、概念图谱、知识卡片，乃至可直接安装的技能包；每条蒸馏命题都带原文定位锚点，可反查原书，实现信息无损压缩与跨场景复用。适用于书籍蒸馏、精华提炼、要点压缩、思维模型抽取、行动方法编译、笔记结构化、知识卡片、概念图谱、把书变技能。逐段精读与文学鉴赏请改用书籍精读类技能。
skills.description_en: A high-fidelity book distillation engine that compresses an entire book into reusable assets. Give it a title or the source text and it returns layered summaries, the full-book skeleton, mental models, action playbooks, concept graphs, knowledge cards, and even an installable skill package. Every distilled proposition carries a source anchor back to the original text, so compression stays lossless and verifiable. Use when the user asks for book distillation, essence extraction, key-point compression, mental model extraction, action-list compilation, structured reading notes, knowledge cards, concept graphs, or turning a book into a skill. Not for line-by-line close reading or literary appreciation.

skills.name: book-distiller

skills.description_en: Distill a book into reusable knowledge assets. skills.description_zh: 品牌策划技能。融合《定位》《疯传》《影响力》《引爆点》《超级符号就是超级创意》《增长黑客》《蓝海战略》《冲突》《战略品牌管理》《非传统营销》等50余本经典品牌营销著作的方法论，产出适配包括但不限于抖音、快手、视频号、B站、小红书、小绿书、微信公众号、微博、知乎、今日头条等主流及新兴媒体平台的高质量策划方案，并对文案、活动、策划、规划等文档进行3-5轮严格审查（错别字、逻辑错误、人员分工、活动时间安排、预算、合规等），逐条修改完善后输出99.9分（满分100分）的完美策划。触发词：品牌策划、品牌营销、品牌定位、营销方案、活动策划、传播策划、品牌文案、小红书文案、抖音脚本、公众号推文、整合营销、品牌升级、新品上市策划。
skills.description_en: Brand planning skill. Fuses methodologies from 50+ classic marketing books (Positioning, Contagious, Influence, The Tipping Point, Super Symbols, Strategic Brand Management, How Brands Grow, Growth Hacker, Blue Ocean Strategy, Conflict) to produce campaign plans adaptable to mainstream and emerging media platforms, including but not limited to Douyin, Kuaishou, WeChat Video, Bilibili, Xiaohongshu, WeChat Channels, WeChat Official Accounts, Weibo, Zhihu and Toutiao. Every deliverable (copy, campaigns, plans, roadmaps) goes through 3-5 rounds of strict review covering typos, logic errors, staffing, scheduling, budget and compliance, then is refined into a polished 99.9/100 plan. Use it for brand planning, brand marketing, brand positioning, campaign planning, brand copywriting and communication strategy.

skills.name: browser-agent
skills.description_zh: 基于 Playwright 的 Agent 式浏览器自动化控制技能。让 AI 像人一样自主操作网页，自动完成登录、搜索、表单填写与提交、数据抓取、批量点击等多步骤页面任务。支持 Chromium、Chrome、Edge、Firefox、WebKit(Safari) 等主流浏览器，内置"观察→决策→执行→验证"闭环，并支持登录态复用（storage_state 免登录）与 Cookie 注入。
skills.description_en: An agentic browser-automation skill built on Playwright. Lets the AI drive web pages like a human to complete multi-step tasks — login, search, form filling and submission, data scraping, and batch clicking. Supports mainstream browsers (Chromium, Chrome, Edge, Firefox, WebKit/Safari) with a built-in observe→decide→act→verify loop, plus login-state reuse (storage_state for passwordless sessions) and cookie injection.

skills.name: browser-automation-cdp
skills.description_zh: 用 Chrome DevTools Protocol 驱动本机真实 Chrome 或 Edge 浏览器，做浏览器自动化与网页数据采集。全程脚本化、零第三方依赖，装好 Python 即可运行。覆盖场景：网页抓取与爬虫（直接抓取被拦、需要先登录、前端动态渲染）、数据采集与网页采集、自动填表与表单提交、自动点击与页面操作、网页截图与整页截图、网页监控与价格监控比价、竞品与商品信息追踪、批量查询与信息核对。相比无头爬虫，真实浏览器带完整指纹，更不容易被识别为机器人，可绕过常见反爬与验证码。能力包括：自动探测或引导安装 Chrome（官方手动下载、自动安装，或用系统自带 Edge 免安装）、以调试模式启动、持久登录态管理、登录过期自动检测与告警、按日期落盘 JSON 与 CSV、环境一键体检。配合定时任务可实现每日自动采集。
skills.description_en: Drive your real local Chrome or Edge through the Chrome DevTools Protocol for browser automation and web scraping. Fully scripted, zero third-party dependencies, Python alone. Covers scraping and crawling blocked by anti-bot walls, login-protected pages, and JavaScript-rendered content; data extraction; form filling and submission; auto clicking; page and full-page screenshots; web monitoring; price tracking and comparison; competitor monitoring; bulk lookups. A real browser with a genuine fingerprint is far less likely to be flagged as a bot than a headless scraper, and it gets past most anti-bot walls and captchas. Features include auto-detect or guided Chrome install (official download or auto-install); zero-install use of the built-in Edge; debug-mode launch; persistent login sessions; automatic login-expiry detection and alerts; JSON and CSV output by date; one-command environment check. Pairs with scheduled automation for daily collection.

skills.description_zh: 一个技能就是一支顶级数据分析团队：首席分析师翻译业务问题，数据工程师体检清洗，统计学家过显著性，行业顾问提炼洞察，复核官专挑毛病。自带 datakit 零依赖工具箱，CSV 丢进去直接出画像、漏斗、留存矩阵、RFM 分层、ABC 分级和显著性检验。电商零售 SaaS 内容平台指标口径全内置，结论都带证据强度和行动建议。

China-first: industry metric packs, promotion-season correction, wan/yi number conventions, PIPL compliance.

skills.name: data-analysis-coordinator
skills.description_zh: 分析 Excel/CSV 文件并生成带图表的业务报告，适用于销售、财务、运营、月度复盘、客户分群、趋势、对比、排名、预算执行和异常波动等场景；完成数据质量检查、聚合分析、洞察与建议，交付 DOCX 和 Markdown。
skills.description_en: Analyze Excel/CSV files and generate chart-backed business reports for sales, finance, operations, monthly reviews, customer segmentation, trends, comparisons, rankings, budget execution, and anomaly scenarios; covers data quality checks, aggregation, insights, and recommendations, delivering DOCX and Markdown. Use when the user provides .xlsx/.xls/.csv files and requests analysis, review, insights, or reports; not for pure format conversion, cleaning, direct database access, SQL, or machine-learning modeling.

skills.name: data-analyst
skills.description_zh: 数据分析师专家，覆盖 SQL 取数、业务指标拆解、同比环比计算、异常值检测与图表选型建议。当用户需要查询数据库或分析 CSV/Excel 数据、拆解 GMV/DAU/转化率/留存等业务指标、判断某个指标波动是否异常、计算同环比、或需要为分析结论配图与做数据看板方案时使用此技能。
skills.description_en: Data analyst expert covering SQL extraction, business metric decomposition, period-over-period comparison, anomaly detection and chart selection. Use when querying databases or analyzing CSV/Excel data, decomposing GMV/DAU/conversion/retention metrics, judging whether a metric swing is anomalous, calculating MoM and YoY, or planning charts and dashboards for analysis conclusions.

skills.name: data-analytics
skills.description_zh: 经营数据分析助手，含 ChatBI 智能问答与图表（历史汇总指标的汇总/趋势/对比/同环比/占比/Top N）和长文分析报告（经营/促销活动/导购任务）。触发词：经营数据分析、BI 统计、经营日报、日报趋势、GMV 趋势、销量排行、经营分析报告、活动分析报告、导购任务分析。
skills.description_en: Analyze historical business metrics through ChatBI summaries, trends, comparisons, rankings and charts, and generate business, campaign and sales-associate reports.

skills.name: data-analyzer
skills.description_zh: 拖一张普通的 Excel 表进来，60 秒给你一份数据质检报告：缺了几个数、重了几行、哪里异常，一条条定位到行和列，还能导出 Excel，照着问题清单改。拖两张表就给你找不同：新增、消失、改了多少，每个变化都带前后值。本地脚本真算，每条结论都能溯源到原数据，产出能存档、能交差的 HTML 报告与 Excel 明细；还能跟上次的检查结果比，只看新增问题。
skills.description_en: Drop one or two spreadsheets; a local script does deterministic computation: single-table data-quality profiling (overall grade by alert severity, six-dimension detail with no composite score, per-column profiles, missing/duplicate/outlier, three-tier alerts), two-table version diff on a user-specified key (three-way row counts: matched / only-in-left / only-in-right, each change with absolute delta and percentage), outputting a double-clickable, traceable HTML report and Excel details — not chat conclusions, but a file you can archive and present.

skills.name: data-query

skills.description_en: Turns raw data into the best-fit chart type and emits runnable code skeletons (matplotlib / Plotly / ECharts). Four-language, multi-version plans covering chart selection, axes, palette, annotations and a readability review. For turning unreadable numbers into instantly clear visuals.

skills.name: dd-financial-analysis

skills.name: dd-industry-analysis

skills.name: de-ai-flavor

skills.name: de-ai-writing

skills.name: deai-promax
skills.description_zh:
去除 AI 味道 PRO MAX 版——蒸馏自 12 个去 AI 味技能，专门针对「朱雀（腾讯 DetectAI）」检测器的五大维度（困惑度 / 突发性 / 语义连贯性 / 词汇分布 / 场景化同质化）做逆向工程，把 AI 率压到安全区。
适用于自媒体（公众号 / 小红书 / 短视频脚本）、小说（网文 / 番茄过审）、文案（营销 / 品牌 / 带货）三类中文创作场景。

De-AI Flavor PRO MAX — a distilled blend of 12 de-AI-writing skills. It reverse-engineers Tencent's Zhuque (DetectAI) detector across five dimensions (perplexity / burstiness / semantic coherence / vocabulary distribution / scene homogenization) to push AI-suspicion rates into the safe zone.

skills.name: deai-rewriter
skills.description_zh: 把带 AI 味的文字改写成自然口语，保留原体裁、事实与观点，支持轻中重三档修改强度。适用于文章、文案、汇报、对话、评论、小说等各种文本。

skills.description_en: AI-powered slide deck generation with consistent visual styling.

skills.name: deep-industry-research
skills.description_zh: 产业极深度研究一体化 skill：对任意行业做系统化深度研究与成品交付（HTML 研报/预期差卡片/封面长图/公众号四件套）。触发词：产业研究、行业研究、行业分析、产业链分析、行业报告、深度报告、赛道研究、竞争分析、护城河、渗透率、市场空间、TAM/SAM/SOM、行业景气度、研报写作、公众号长图、预期差、证伪、反共识。

skills.name: deep-reading-companion

Use when the user wants deep reading, close reading, or to fully understand a book or long material (textbook, PDF, report, paper). Textbook read-through, ask anytime, deep answers with gap-filling and checkpoints. Self-evolving knowledge base with per-round checklists and exception-handling protocols.

skills.name: deep-research

skills.name: deep-research-agent

skills.description_en: End-to-end deep research agent that runs the full pipeline: question refinement, parallel multi-agent research, Graph of Thoughts graph control, knowledge synthesis and citation verification. Use when the user needs comprehensive, multi-source, fully cited research on any topic. Give it a research topic or question and it handles everything from clarifying requirements to producing the final report. Handles complex, multi-faceted subjects by deploying several research agents in parallel, with source triangulation, consensus building, conflict resolution and citation accuracy checks built in.

skills.description_en: End-to-end retrieval loop for a research task across local notes, files, past conversations and the public web, producing a markdown draft plus a single-file HTML report. Use when the user searches, inventories, summarizes, compares multiple documents, or traces where a metric or error code appears. Do NOT use for single-file reads, plain Q and A needing no retrieval, outline-to-prose drafting, end-to-end multi-agent research, or structured live data.

skills.name: deep-skill-finder

skills.name: deep-thinking

Separate facts from assumptions, test alternative explanations, and explain trade-offs and what would change the conclusion. Works with questions or supplied materials; no specific note app, paid API, or multi-agent tool is required. skills.name: delivery-no-pseudoblock
skills.description_zh: AI交付前全自动自检技能。任何一次向用户交付结果（present_files、最终总结、结论、状态汇报、提问/征询）之前，必须实际加载并实跑本技能，对整条回复（含结尾）逐项枚举 D1–D12 闸门快照，拦截责任转嫁、半途交付、最优步隐藏、伪阻断提问、尾巴豁免、自主闭环缺失、语言后门、先盖章后干活等把活推回用户或以声明替代实际扫描的形态。无真实加载状态即视为未过闸。适用于所有项目、所有交付形态的发送前强制终检。

skills.name: design-master

（<w:ins> 插入、<w:del> 删除，带作者与时间），并在 settings.xml 开启 trackChanges，使输出文档仍处于「修订/审阅状态」，
所有修改记录可见。支持：正文与单元格字符级留痕；表格内文字、整行、整列、整表增删留痕；图片换图/补图留痕；
文本框内部递归留痕；单元格合并/拆分留痕；格式修订（rPrChange/pPrChange/tblPrChange/trPrChange/tcPrChange）；
批注（w:comment）；文件命名规则（原名_版本_修订人_时间 + _留痕）；任务转交防护；全文端到端校验；
base 分叉 A/B 并行改的三方合并。当用户提到「修订留痕」「修改留痕」「审阅模式改 Word」「带修订记录」
「track changes」「redline」「表格留痕」「合并单元格」「拆分单元格」「换图留痕」「文件命名」「任务转交」
「格式修订」「字体颜色变化留痕」「批注」「comment」时触发此技能。
skills.description_en:
A Word document "redline / track-changes" generator. It compares an original .docx with a revised .docx and writes every
insertion/deletion as standard OOXML revision markup (<w:ins> for inserts, <w:del> for deletes, with author and timestamp),
and enables trackChanges in settings.xml so the output stays in review mode with all changes visible.
Supported: character-level redline for body text and table cells; row/column/table insert-delete redline; image replace/insert
redline; text-box internal recursive redline; cell merge/split redline; format revisions (rPrChange/pPrChange/tblPrChange/
trPrChange/tcPrChange); comments (w:comment); filename convention (name_version_author_date + _redline); handoff protection;
end-to-end accept-equivalence verification; three-way merge of parallel A/B edits from a base.
Trigger when the user mentions 修订留痕 / 修改留痕 / 审阅模式 / track changes / redline / 表格留痕 / 合并单元格 /
拆分单元格 / 换图留痕 / 文件命名 / 任务转交 / 格式修订 / 批注 / comment.

skills.description_en: Analyzes a natural-language request, searches local skill and expert libraries, ranks candidates with author-owned assets prioritized, and returns a Top list of best matches, each with its name, match reason, applicable scenarios and concrete invocation advice.

skills.description_en: Trigger when the user wants to find/search/install a skill: is there a skill for X, find/search/recommend/install a skill, which skill can do X, find a skill, search for skill, skill for XXX. Adapted from find-skills by vercel-labs/skills, the number-one most-installed skill on skills.sh. First prioritize the user's own uploaded/owned skills and skills by a designated preferred developer (e.g. Jiuzi Lihuo), then search via WorkBuddy native capabilities and the web, dedupe, rank by Health Score (0-100), security-scan candidates, and present a recommendation list with one-click install/enable.

skills.name: first-principles
skills.description_zh: 把复杂问题还原到底层事实与物理约束，从零重建答案的深度分析助手。通过物理法则过滤器区分不可妥协的铁律与可打破的假约束，用理论完美倒推法量化现实与最优解的差距，再通过强制排序收敛到唯一该做的事，最后用愿望思维检测器检验结论中的乐观假设与自欺。适用于重大决策、战略选择、瓶颈诊断、创业方向判断、技术路线取舍，以及任何"大家都这么做但说不清为什么"的场景。输出结构化分析报告：硬核约束、完美终局、唯一优先级、被打破的假约束、未验证假设清单与诚实自检。
skills.description_en: A deep-analysis agent that strips problems down to underlying facts and physical constraints, then rebuilds the answer from scratch. It separates non-negotiable physical laws from breakable human conventions, quantifies the gap between current reality and the theoretically optimal outcome, forces a single highest-leverage priority, and stress-tests the conclusion for wishful thinking and unverified assumptions. Use it for major decisions, strategy choices, bottleneck diagnosis, startup direction, technology trade-offs, and any situation where 'everyone does it this way' is the only justification. Delivers a structured report covering the hard-core constraint, perfect end state, single priority, broken false constraints, ranked assumptions and honest self-check.

skills.name: first-principles-decomposer
skills.description_zh: 将复杂问题分解为基本真理并从原子层面重建解决方案；当用户说"第一性原理"、"从零开始"、"打破常规"、"根本问题"或挑战现有假设时使用。
skills.description_en: Decomposes complex problems into fundamental truths and rebuilds solutions from the atomic level—for when users say "first principles," "from scratch," "break the convention," "root cause," or want to challenge existing assumptions.

skills.name: fitness-coach
skills.description_zh: 给普通人的循证健身指导。先评估再定目标，出可落地的每周训练表（含热身、动作要点、常见错误、组数次数与休息）、三餐与热量蛋白建议、恢复与拉伸安排，并纠正流传的健身谣言。内置合规红线：不看病、不荐药与补剂、不承诺速成、不给伤病恢复期方案，每次输出都带健康声明。资料全在包内，离线可用。
skills.description_en: Evidence-based fitness coaching for everyday people — assess first, set realistic goals, then produce a weekly training plan (warm-up, cue-by-cue technique, common errors, sets/reps/rest), calorie and protein guidance, recovery and stretching, and myth-busting. Hard guardrails are built in — no diagnosis, no supplements or drugs, no quick-fix promises, no rehab programming for injuries; a health disclaimer opens and closes every answer. Works fully offline.

skills.name: floorplan-render
skills.description_zh: 读户型图识别全部房间，按指定风格一次性批量生成全屋装修效果图；强制同批输出真实比例平面俯视图（四层尺寸标注 + 墙体厚度 + 十一项工程自检，FAIL=0 才交付）。平面图未确认，一张效果图都不出；效果图提示词由脚本从布局数据生成、逐字复制使用，禁止人工转写。4.0 起内置两道安全闸：上传图安全审核 + 生成前合规校验——组装完不等于能发。居住画像（老人/儿童/宠物/居家办公）自动转为出图硬约束：儿童房圆角家具、老人房预留扶手位、紧凑空间收纳优先。一致性如实分级：L1 结构可保证、L2 件数多数可保证、L3 朝向不可靠、L4 尺寸与占墙比例做不到（以平面图为准，不吹完全一致）。4.7 起同户型可用一个 seed 保跨房一致、一次出多个风格版本对比、每房四机位环拍做漫游；并附水电施工参考（回路划分/插座点位/给排水点/防水面积/材料清单，从平面数据驱动，对齐 GB 规范）。附逐图 17 项质检与平台水印后处理、可施工性判定、物料清单与房源营销文案。
skills.description_en: Reads a floor plan, detects every room, and batch-generates whole-home renders in a chosen style. A true-scale top-down 2D floor plan is a mandatory companion output (four layers of dimensions, wall thickness, eleven engineering self-checks; nothing ships until FAIL=0). No render is produced before the plan view is confirmed, and every prompt is script-generated from the layout JSON, copied verbatim - never hand-written. Two safety gates since 4.0 (uploaded-image safety review plus pre-generation compliance check). Occupant profiles (elderly / children / pets / home office) become hard render constraints - rounded children's furniture, grab-bar space in senior rooms, storage-first layouts. Consistency is graded honestly - L1 structure guaranteed, L2 item count mostly guaranteed, L3 orientation unreliable, L4 size and wall-coverage ratio not achievable (the plan view governs). Ships 17-point QC with watermark post-processing, buildability verdicts, material lists and listing copy.

skills.name: floorplan-to-render
skills.description_zh: 上传户型图即可生成全套装修效果图：解读户型格局、选定装修风格、逐房间生成写实效果图与全屋 3D 鸟瞰图，并组装成带色卡、设计说明与落地清单的自包含 HTML 设计报告。
skills.description_en: Upload a floor plan and get a full rendering package: layout reading, style selection, per-room photorealistic renderings plus a 3D aerial view, assembled into a self-contained HTML report with palette, design notes and landing checklist.

Supports flowcharts, architecture diagrams, sequence diagrams, class diagrams, mind maps, timelines, principle illustrations, state machines, and data-flow diagrams. Outputs a standalone .svg file with embedded styles.

skills.description_zh: Flyelep AI 电商视觉创作技能集，一站式覆盖 AI 生图、图片设计与电商海报制作。支持生成产品主图、白底图、详情页海报与 banner，适配亚马逊、Shopify、TikTok Shop 等跨境电商与国内电商平台，支持多语言文案排版、参考图输入与任意比例控制。内置 AI 抠图去背景、智能扩图延展、局部重绘、商品换色、商品替换、场景背景替换、图片文字翻译、无损放大、超清增强等图片处理能力；并支持爆款图片与爆款视频复刻、视频创作（主图视频、种草视频、品牌宣传片、自由创作）、AI 帮写文案、本地图片视频音频上传换取永久直链。共 16 个技能，均基于 Flyelep 开放平台 API，支持同步与异步批量调用，适用于电商设计、商品图美化、营销素材批量生产等场景。关键词：AI 生图、文生图、图生图、AI 绘画、海报设计、创意设计、商品图、种草图、电商美工、AI 视频。
skills.description_en: Flyelep AI e-commerce visual creation skill pack: an all-in-one toolkit for AI image generation, graphic design and e-commerce poster production. Generate product main images, white-background hero shots, detail-page posters and banners for Amazon, Shopify, TikTok Shop and other cross-border marketplaces, with multi-language copywriting, reference images and flexible aspect ratios. Includes AI background removal and cutout matting, smart image extension and outpainting, partial redraw and inpainting, product color change, product replacement, scene and background replacement, in-image text translation, lossless upscaling and HD clarity enhancement. Also covers viral image and video replication, text-to-video generation for product demos, review-style promos and brand films, AI copywriting, and image, video and audio upload to permanent public links. 16 skills powered by the Flyelep open-platform API, with sync and async batch calls, ideal for e-commerce design and marketing assets.

skills.name: football-analysis-v9
skills.description_zh: 足球赛事数据研究方法论（v9.9 标准定义框架）。基于首发身价、主场优势、近期状态与磨合、积分榜排名、相似对阵比分、历史交锋、其他因素多维加权合成 90 分钟赛果概率，结合泊松比分模型与分联赛基线，输出概率倾向与三个模型比分，回测同时给概率倾向吻合率与比分吻合率，并内置回测闭环持续校准。本公开版含完整分析框架与示例联赛基线，完整基线表与模型参数由服务端下发。适用于足球赛事数据分析、量化模型教学与模型回测研究。触发词：足球分析、赛事分析、足球数据、赛果概率、比分研究、赛事数据、足球回测、比赛分析。
skills.description_en: Football match data research methodology (v9.9 standard-definition framework). Synthesizes 90-minute match outcome probability from multiple weighted dimensions (squad value, home advantage, recent form, league ranking, similar fixtures, head-to-head record, other factors), combined with a Poisson scoreline model and per-league baselines to output probability tendency and three model scorelines, with a built-in back-testing loop for continuous calibration. This public edition ships the full analytical framework plus sample league baselines; the complete baseline table and model parameters are served from the developer backend. For football match data analysis, quantitative research, and model back-testing.

skills.description_en: Football Bayesian analysis based on public data (not betting advice), supporting batch processing, duplicate query re-fetching, and edge intent handling.

skills.name: football-data

skills.description_en: Football data query assistant. Look up league standings, fixtures and results, team and player stats, and pre-match H2H previews. Informational queries only, no betting. Triggers include football standings, fixtures, team info, player stats, football data, H2H and league data.

skills.name: football-score-prediction
skills.description_zh: 面向小样本联赛的比分预测建模工作流：Dixon-Coles 双变量泊松 + 时间衰减加权 + 强度收缩 + 平局膨胀校准 + 蒙特卡洛赛季推演，并强制执行"开发集调参 / 留出集冻结验证 / 双基线对照 / 配对 bootstrap 显著性检验"的回测协议。输出比分概率矩阵、赛季末排名分布与逐场 1X2 概率，并如实交付模型的能力边界。
skills.description_en: A complete workflow for building calibrated football scoreline prediction models on sparse, small-sample leagues (amateur, semi-pro, city leagues). Dixon-Coles bivariate Poisson with time decay, strength shrinkage, draw-inflation calibration and Monte Carlo season simulation, plus a mandatory backtest protocol (dev/holdout split, two naive baselines, paired bootstrap). Outputs scoreline probability matrices, season-end rank distributions and per-match 1X2 probabilities, with an honest statement of the model's capability limits.

skills.name: fore-vip-geo-optimizer
skills.description_zh: GEO 生成式引擎引用占位助手。输入主题或产品名称，执行五步流水线：用真实用户问句检索 AI 搜索（豆包 / Kimi / DeepSeek / 秘塔等）并收集引用来源 → 分析来源站点的可发布性与权重、优选高权重阵地 → 按 SEO 模板一次性收集关键词 / 人群 / 卖点 / 背书 / CTA → 输出结构化、可摘录、带 FAQ 的合规 Markdown 文档 → 给出各平台发布引导（公众号可走草稿推送直发）。
skills.description_en: GEO (Generative Engine Optimization) assistant for earning citations in AI answers. Given a topic or product name, it runs a five-stage pipeline: query AI search engines (Doubao / Kimi / DeepSeek / Metaso) with real user questions and collect cited sources; analyze each source site for publishability and authority, prioritizing high-authority outlets; collect keywords / audience / selling points / proof / CTA via an SEO template; produce structured, quotable, FAQ-ready Markdown; give per-platform publishing guidance, with WeChat official accounts pushable directly as drafts.

skills.description_en: A cross-platform (macOS/Windows/Linux) PC cleanup and performance optimization assistant. Layered rules (identity/memory/profile/skill/external) + five disposal actions (keep/merge/compress/move-to-skill/archive) + safety guardrails with zero information loss. Runs as a scheduled auto-inspection task; no manual trigger needed.

团队知识散落在聊天记录、文档、邮件里？新人入职找不到资料，同一问题反复问，离职后经验断层。
本 Skill 自动把你分享的文章和对话中的洞察沉淀为结构化知识页，建立交叉引用形成可查询的知识图谱。一篇文章、一次灵感、一个决策——全部变成团队可复用的资产，不再靠人脑记忆。
skills.description_en:
Team knowledge scattered across chats, docs, and emails? New hires can't find answers, the same questions get asked repeatedly, and expertise walks out the door when people leave.
This Skill automatically ingests articles and conversation insights into structured knowledge pages with cross-references, building a queryable knowledge graph. One article, one insight, one decision — all become reusable team assets, no longer relying on human memory.

skills.description_en: Turn a narration script into a publishable vertical video. Built on HyperFrames, treating HTML/CSS/JS as the video source: give it pasted text, a .txt (UTF-8 or GBK) or a .docx, it splits scenes, synthesises Chinese narration, burns captions in, and renders 1080x1920 MP4. Durations and frame counts derive from the measured audio, so nothing drifts. The script is never rewritten. If Node or Chrome are missing it still returns a storyboard, an SRT and a previewable project. No editor and no CLI.

It only sends scheduled reminders, tracks check-in streaks, and protects against missed days — no simulated clicks or API reverse-engineering. Main reminder at 09:00 and a fallback at 20:00 daily, auto-records consecutive days, and tracks the 7/14/28-day milestone rewards (with a make-up card mechanism, max 4). Trigger words: 领积分 / 签到提醒 / 积分打卡 / buddy积分.

skills.description_en: Legal information assistant for labor disputes. Explains basic labor law concepts, organizes labor dispute facts, drafts documents such as labor arbitration applications, forced-resignation notices and negotiated severance agreements, prepares evidence checklists, and explains arbitration and litigation procedures. For reference only, not legal advice; consult a licensed lawyer or the local labor arbitration committee on important matters.

skills.name: labor-dispute-fullcycle

It covers the entire chain from recruitment and onboarding, rules and regulations, labor contracts, remuneration, attendance and assessment, disciplinary termination, in-service disputes, work injury and social insurance, labor dispatch, to arbitration and litigation enforcement. Integrates the practical content of the Labor Law Practice Manual (2024), from a lawyer's practice perspective, suitable for representing either party.

skills.name: labor-law-advisor

Classifies an issue (onboarding, hours and leave, pay, termination, severance, dispute procedure) and provides fact-check lists, evidence-preservation checklists, statute-direction pointers and common-misconception alerts, plus a procedure roadmap and when-to-see-a-lawyer guidance. Informational only, not legal advice.

Given a vertical talking-head video (with optional BGM), it auto-completes: Whisper base transcription → manual typo fix → silence / breath removal → subtitle burn-in → BGM mixing → image processing to generate a 3:4 eye-catching cover image. Supports three subtitle styles (default minimal white / bold highlighted bilingual / minimal white + bilingual) and picture-in-picture overlay (preserving original aspect ratio). Mainland China law only.

Automatically separates red seals from body text, extracts text inside seals, ignores background watermarks and headers/footers, and corrects legal and technical terminology. Built-in GB/T 9704 typesetting standards (page setup, fonts, sizes, line spacing, signatures) and a deterministic DOCX generation script produce professional, consistent drafts in one click. Assessment reports follow a standard structure covering risk index and rating, risk alerts, recommended actions, resolution channels, time and economic costs, legal citations, and a disclaimer. Suitable for lawyers, corporate counsel, and individual litigants drafting litigation documents and assessing litigation risk.

skills.description_en: Aggregated TikTok Shop research and creator shoppable-video capability through LinkFox MCP, combining EchoTik and FastMoss product data with creator authorization, product lookup, content precheck, publishing, and status tracking.

skills.name: linkfox-wb-1688-sourcing
skills.description_zh: 面向1688采购与选品的货源发现能力：按中文关键词筛选商品和供应商、按图片寻找相似货源、查看周/月热销榜单，并对已知商品的SKU价格、库存、起批量、物流和供应商信息进行核验。当用户说1688找货源、批发采购、工厂货源、一件代发、以图找同款、1688热销榜或查询1688商品详情时触发；仅提供数据检索与事实整理，不代替下单、付款、质量认证或法律判断。
skills.description_en: Unified 1688 sourcing discovery for keyword-based product and supplier search, image-based lookalike sourcing, weekly or monthly bestseller browsing, and known-offer detail verification covering SKU prices, inventory, MOQ, logistics, and supplier facts. Use when users ask to find 1688 wholesale sources, factory suppliers, dropship products, visual matches, trending products, or details for a known 1688 offer or URL. It provides factual retrieval and comparison only, not ordering, payment, quality certification, or legal advice.

skills.name: linkfox-wb-amazon-front-data
skills.description_zh: 面向亚马逊前台实时数据获取与分析，支持按关键词查看搜索结果与排位、按 ASIN 获取商品详情、按星级与条件读取评论、按公开图片查找视觉相似商品，以及通过 Alexa 购物助手进行自然语言导购问答。当用户需要亚马逊前台快照、竞品研究、Listing 数据、买家反馈、图片找同款或对话式商品推荐时触发；输出结构化结果、链接、图片和可追溯的原始响应。该能力不提供历史搜索量、广告投放、库存管理或法律结论。
skills.description_en: Real-time Amazon storefront data retrieval and analysis for search SERPs, ASIN product details, filtered customer reviews, visual product discovery from public image URLs, and Alexa conversational shopping answers. Use it for Amazon storefront snapshots, competitor research, listing data, customer feedback, image-based lookalike discovery, or conversational product recommendations. It returns structured results, links, images, and traceable raw responses, but does not provide historical search analytics, advertising management, inventory operations, or legal conclusions.

skills.name: linkfox-wb-linkfox-aigc
skills.description_zh: 根据提示词、商品图片和品牌要求生成商品与服装营销套图，支持单图修图、多图融合、文案及媒体理解，并可生成单图或多场景视频、模板化商品视频和带货口播视频，复刻参考视频、编辑已有视频及翻译视频语音和同步口型。适用于Listing、广告创意与商品内容本地化。
skills.description_en: Create product and apparel marketing images, videos and copy. Supports image editing and fusion, single-image and multi-reference video generation, product video templates, sales narration, video recreation, editing, translation and lip sync, plus text generation and media understanding.

skills.name: linkfox-wb-seerfar-ozon
skills.description_zh: 面向 Ozon 选品与竞品研究的统一数据分析能力：可浏览市场热词、围绕种子词挖掘长尾词、按 SKU 反查自然词与广告词、分析店铺和类目、筛选商品报表并查看单品销量趋势、库存和排名。用户需要 Ozon 市场机会发现、关键词研究、商品筛选、店铺拆解、类目分析或单品评估时触发。结果来自 Seerfar 数据接口，完整参数、响应字段和错误码见 references/。
skills.description_en: Unified Ozon product-research and competitive-analysis capability for discovering market opportunities, mining and reverse-looking-up keywords, screening products, analyzing shops and categories, and deep-diving into one SKU's sales trend, stock, ranking, brand, and seller data. Use when the user needs Ozon market, keyword, product, shop, category, or listing research. Results come from Seerfar data endpoints; full parameters, response fields, and error codes are documented in references/.

skills.name: linkfox-wb-sellersprite
skills.description_zh: 面向亚马逊卖家的卖家精灵数据分析能力：按关键词、ASIN、卖家、品牌或类目发现并筛选商品，评估细分类目市场规模与竞争结构，查看节点统计看板，并反查 ASIN 的自然与广告流量关键词。当用户需要亚马逊选品、竞品研究、市场机会筛选、类目质量判断或 ASIN 流量词分析时触发。支持实时近 30 天与可用历史月份数据；完整参数、响应字段和错误处理见 references/。
skills.description_en: SellerSprite data analysis for Amazon product selection and market decisions. discover and filter products by keyword, ASIN, seller, brand, or category; evaluate category-market size and competitive structure; inspect node-level market statistics; and reverse-lookup an ASIN's organic and advertising traffic keywords. Use when the user needs Amazon product selection, competitor research, market opportunity screening, category quality assessment, or ASIN traffic-keyword analysis. Supports near-real-time 30-day data and available historical monthly snapshots. Full parameters, response fields, and error handling are in references/.

skills.name: lisp-programming-assistant
skills.description_zh: AutoLISP 编程开发助手——连接 CAD 自动跑 LISP 完成初步调试。需配合 tmagent-cad 插件。报错先看「分段原文」指认的出错段，需要时加 stack=true 取行号＋调用栈；可按需调用 TmAgent 工具勘察图元、搭测试环境、回读核对。触发词：写 lisp、AutoLISP、lsp、代码。
skills.description_en: AutoLISP programming assistant - connects to CAD and runs LISP automatically for initial debugging (requires the tmagent-cad plugin). On error read the segment line to find the failing top-level expression, pass stack=true for line numbers + call stack when needed, and call TmAgent tools to inspect entities, build test environments, and cross-check.

skills.name: listing-images
skills.description_zh: 根据真实商品照片、SKU信息和卖点生成一套电商主图与副图。适用于商品套图、电商套图、上架套图、Listing images、Amazon图片、淘宝商品图。美图设计室提供。
skills.description_en: Create a complete image set for ecommerce listings.

skills.name: literature-deep-reading
skills.description_zh: 学术文献精读与PPT大纲生成。上传PDF论文后，按11个板块（文献基本资料、研究内容、方法、样本量、研究时间、图表解析、结论、创新点、局限性、可复刻性、核心要点）生成结构化Markdown格式的PPT汇报大纲。第10-11板块结合用户研究背景进行个性化分析。触发词：精读文献、文献分析、论文精读、PPT大纲、文献汇报。
skills.description_en: Structured critical reading of academic papers with PPT outline generation. After uploading a PDF, produces an 11-section structured Markdown PPT outline (bibliographic data, research content, methods, sample size, study period, figure/table analysis, conclusions, innovations, limitations, reproducibility, key takeaways). Sections 10-11 are personalized to the user's research background. Triggers: deep-read a paper, literature analysis, paper close reading, PPT outline, literature presentation.

skills.name: literature-report-ppt
skills.description_zh: 一站式文献汇报 PPT 生成流水线：提取原文全部 Figure/Table（大组图逐子图裁剪）→ 精读 → 逐页文字稿 → 套模板出可编辑 PPTX → 三道自动质检。用户提供 .pptx 模板时强制真套用模板文件本身（母版/版式/主题/徽标全继承，封面·目录·尾页整页克隆，删除模板自带设定说明页）；无模板时用封面概念图提取的六角色配色定整套配色；标题一律名词短语去 AI 味；每页正文 ≤5 行、解释性内容下备注、版面不留白。适用于医学、生命科学、理工、人文社科等各学科。
skills.description_en: Turns paper or guideline PDFs into an editable, presentation-ready literature report deck. Identifies each paper type, extracts every original figure and table (multi-panel figures split per sub-panel), runs a deep-reading pass, drafts a per-slide manuscript with source traceability, then builds an editable PPTX on the user or institution template. A supplied .pptx template is applied: master, layouts, theme fonts and logo inherited, cover, TOC and closing pages cloned then rewritten, setup page removed. Without a template, a cover concept image is generated first and its palette drives the deck. Titles are noun phrases, no page numbers, body within 5 lines per slide, detail in speaker notes, three audits before delivery. Works across disciplines including medicine, life sciences, engineering and the humanities. Trigger on literature report deck, paper-to-PPT, guideline briefing, multi-paper review, template application, figure walkthrough.

skills.name: literature-research
skills.description_zh: 学术文献检索与综述技能：检索策略、证据分级（Ⅰ-Ⅴ）、溯源核验、主题聚类与引用清单，交付可直接使用的文献综述。
skills.description_en: Academic literature search and review: PICO search strategy, evidence grading, source verification and citation lists ready for a paper.

skills.name: litigation-docs-generator
skills.description_zh: 民商事诉讼文书成套生成技能（诉状文本生成）。自动生成民事起诉状、诉讼保全申请书、授权委托书、所函、利息计算表、委托代理合同等10份配套文书，联动要素式起诉状生成；被告为自然人时提示是否调取人口信息，无锡律师可一并生成《案件当事人授权委托书》《查询人口信息业务申请表》两份公安制式表。
skills.description_en: Generate a full set of civil litigation documents (complaint drafting): civil complaint, preservation application, power of attorney, law firm letter, interest calculation sheet, retainer agreement and more, with optional element-style complaint generation. When a defendant is a natural person, it prompts whether to retrieve household registration information and, for Wuxi lawyers, produces the two Wuxi police forms (case-party authorization and population-information inquiry application).

skills.name: litigation-evidence-catalog
skills.description_zh: 按用户既有模板把一方证据整理成结构化 Word 证据目录。
skills.description_en: Compile a party's exhibits into a structured Word evidence catalog using the user's template.

skills.name: live-selling-script
skills.description_zh: 全网第一质量的全平台直播带货脚本输出引擎（抖音/快手/视频号/淘宝/京东/拼多多/小红书/美团八平台矩阵）。只要用户有任何直播带货脚本类需求（平台选型/直播话术/单品脚本/全场流程/开场留人/憋单逼单/互动设计/货盘结构/起号或平播或大促脚本/数据复盘诊断/已有脚本升级，指定或不指定平台品类均可），即深度挖掘需求、按三波联网协议校准 2026-09 最新各平台算法与合规口径、融合八大资源库，一键输出分钟级可照读的导演级直播脚本（逐字话术 + 助播动作 + 场控指令 + 数据目标 + 平台特有联动 + 异常预案），并强制过跨平台合规扫描与十六维评分硬门禁，Markdown 落盘交付。
skills.description_en: The most powerful multi-platform live commerce script engine covering Douyin, Kuaishou, WeChat Channels, Taobao, JD, Pinduoduo, Xiaohongshu and Meituan. From zero input to full-session briefs, it produces a minute-by-minute director-grade live script with verbatim host lines, co-host actions, floor-director cues, quantified data targets and platform-specific mechanics, auto-switching traffic logic, talk style and compliance wordlists by target platform, gated by a cross-platform compliance scan and a 16-dimension quality check.

skills.name: llm-wiki
skills.description_zh: 用 LLM 增量构建和维护个人知识库 Wiki
skills.description_en: Build a persistent personal wiki with LLM-maintained knowledge

skills.name: local-asr
skills.description_zh:
英特尔 Windows 本地离线语音识别。当用户使用中文或英文要求转录音频或视频文件、将语音转换为文字，或从录音中提取文本时使用此技能。触发词包括“转录/转写/转文字/识别/提取文本”“把……转成文字/语音转文本/音频转文字/视频转文字”，以及 transcribe/recognize/convert-to-text/extract-text 和对“英特尔/intel/AIPC/本地/离线/offline/ASR”的明确提及。

支持的输入：
- 音频文件：.wav、.mp3、.flac、.m4a、.ogg、.aac、.wma、.opus
- 视频文件（自动提取音轨）：.mp4、.mkv、.webm、.flv、.mov、.avi、.mts、.m2ts、.ts、.m3u8
- 30 种语言和 22 种汉语方言，支持自动语言检测

当用户需要本地语音转文字时，优先使用此技能，而不是云端 ASR API 或临时编写的 Python 脚本。
skills.description_en: Transcribe audio and video files locally on Intel Windows AI PCs.

skills.name: local-audio-transcribe
skills.description_zh: 本地(无云端、无预算)将音频文件(m4a/mp3/wav 等)转写为带时间戳的 UTF-8 文本。链路为 PyAV 解码 + scipy 谱减法降噪 + faster-whisper 转写,支持说话人分离(语义法)与语义纠错。应在用户要求音频转文字、语音转写、录音转文字,或上传/引用音频文件、需要带时间戳的转写文本时使用。
skills.description_en: Transcribe local audio files (m4a/mp3/wav, etc.) into timestamped UTF-8 text entirely offline and free of cloud services. Pipeline: PyAV decoding + scipy spectral-subtraction denoising + faster-whisper transcription, with optional speaker diarization (semantic method) and semantic correction. Use when the user asks to transcribe audio, or uploads/references an audio file needing timestamped text.

skills.name: local-computer-use
skills.description_zh: 英特尔 Windows 本地计算机使用。用于查询或更改 Windows 系统状态及设置，包括 CPU、GPU、NPU、内存、硬盘、电源、电池、声音、麦克风、鼠标、键盘、摄像头、打印机、蓝牙、WIFI、网络、分辨率、亮度、主题、壁纸、任务栏、应用、账户、语言、时区、输入法、隐私和通知。触发词包括“打开/关闭/设置/调整/切换/查询/查看/列出”及 open/turn on/turn off/set/adjust/switch/query/list。即使是“关掉广告”“打开蓝牙”等简单请求，也应优先使用此技能。
skills.description_en: Query and change supported Windows settings locally on Intel AI PCs.

skills.name: local-image-ocr
skills.description_zh: 本机离线图片识字技能：本地部署 PP-OCRv3（DB 检测 + 方向分类 + CTC 识别），推理全程在本机 GPU、图片不外传、不按次计费。当用户发来图片、截图、扫描件、照片，要识别或提取里面的文字、截图取字、扫描件转文字、拍照转文字时使用。目录可递归批量，结果为文本框坐标 + 文字 + 置信度；水平文本稳定，旋转/竖排文本是已知短板会明示。触发词：图片识字、图片转文字、提取图中文字、截图取字、截图转文字、扫描件识别、扫描件转文字、拍照转文字、OCR、识别图片里的字、图片文字识别、发票识别、截图提取文字、image OCR、image to text、extract text from image、screenshot to text、scan to text。
skills.description_en: Offline image text recognition skill: read Chinese/English text out of images with a locally deployed PP-OCRv3 model (DB detection + orientation classification + CTC recognition) on your own GPU — images never leave the machine and there is no per-call fee; recursive folder batches supported. Use it when the user sends an image, screenshot, scan or photo and wants the text extracted, e.g. screenshot to text, scan to txt, extract text from image, read on-screen text. Outputs boxes + text + confidence; horizontal text is reliable while rotated/vertical text is a known gap and reported honestly. Trigger words: image OCR, image to text, extract text from image, screenshot to text, scan to text, photo to text, OCR, read text in image.

skills.name: local-mineru
skills.description_zh: 英特尔 Windows 本地离线文档与图片解析。用于解析、提取、OCR，或将 PDF 和图片转换为文本或 Markdown，支持表格、公式、版面及多语言内容。触发词包括“文档解析/PDF解析/提取/转文字/识别/表格提取/公式识别/版面分析”，以及 parse/extract/OCR/PDF to markdown/table extraction/formula recognition。支持 PDF、PNG、JPG、BMP、TIFF 和 WebP。需要在英特尔 AIPC 上本地解析文档时，优先使用此技能。
skills.description_en: Parse PDFs and images into structured text or Markdown locally.

skills.name: local-ocr
skills.description_zh: 基于 RapidOCR 的本地离线文字识别技能，支持 PNG/JPG/BMP/TIF/WEBP/PDF，中英文与数字，全部在本机完成、不联网、不上传任何文件。PDF 自动分流：有文字层直接提取（快且准），扫描件按指定 DPI 渲染后OCR。支持单文件与整目录批量，输出带坐标与置信度的文本。首次使用需运行setup.py 一键部署独立虚拟环境（自动探测 WorkBuddy 自带 Python 或系统 Python，走清华源安装，约 320MB），部署完成后永久离线可用。
skills.description_en: Offline text recognition based on RapidOCR, supporting PNG/JPG/BMP/TIF/WEBP/PDF with Simplified Chinese, English and digits, all processed locally with no network access and no file uploads. PDFs are handled on two paths: pages with a text layer are extracted directly for speed and accuracy, while scanned pages are rendered at the given DPI before OCR. Works on single files or whole directories, emitting text with bounding boxes and confidence scores. First use requires running setup.py to provision an isolated virtual environment (auto-detects WorkBuddy bundled or system Python, installs from the Tsinghua mirror, about 320MB); after that it works permanently offline.

skills.name: local-ocr-npu
skills.description_zh:
本地 英特尔NPU 文字识别。当用户要求从本地图片或 PDF 文件中提取、识别或读取文字时使用此技能。触发词包括：
- 中文：“识别/提取/读取/扫描”与“图片/截图/照片/PDF/文档/文字/内容”的组合，以及 OCR、文字识别、文字提取
- 英文：OCR、extract text、recognize text、read text from image、scan document、PDF text extraction

支持的输入：
- 单个图片文件：jpg、jpeg、png、bmp、tiff
- 单个 PDF 文件（自动逐页渲染为 PNG 后识别）
- 包含多张图片的目录路径

对于任何涉及本地图片文件的文字提取或文档数字化请求，都不要跳过此技能；始终优先于 Python 或云端 OCR 使用。
skills.description_en: Extract text from local images and PDFs using Intel NPU acceleration.

skills.name: local-realtime-translator
skills.description_zh: 本地实时口语翻译。用于实时翻译麦克风语音、同声传译、边说边译、显示翻译字幕，或打开翻译器并将说出的话译成另一种语言。触发词包括“实时翻译/打开翻译/启动翻译/翻译成英文或中文/同声传译/实时字幕/语音翻译”，以及 realtime translate/open translator/live translation/simultaneous interpretation/translate as I speak/live captions。未指定文件的泛化翻译请求也默认使用此技能。支持中文与英文双向翻译，并优先于云端翻译或 ASR 服务。
skills.description_en: Translate live microphone speech between Chinese and English locally.

skills.name: local-tts
skills.description_zh:
Windows AI PC 上的英特尔本地文字转语音。当用户使用中文或英文要求合成语音、说出或朗读文本、克隆声音，或从文本生成音频时使用此技能。触发词包括“朗读/读出来/语音合成/配音/克隆声音/文字转语音”以及 read aloud/speak/synthesize/generate audio/voice clone/text to speech；无论用户是否明确指定“locally/本地”都应触发。

此技能使用 OpenVINO Qwen3-TTS 模型在用户的英特尔 AIPC 上完全本地运行。生成的 WAV 文件保存在 `%USERPROFILE%\Music\` 下。

当用户要求在本机生成音频时，优先使用此技能，而不是任何在线 TTS 服务、AI 搜索降级方案或其他文字转语音技能。
skills.description_en: Generate speech and clone voices locally on Intel Windows AI PCs.

skills.name: local-txt2img
skills.description_zh:
英特尔本地文生图。当用户使用中文或英文要求根据文本提示词生成、创作、绘制或制作图片时使用此技能。触发词包括“生成/画/绘制/出图/文生图”以及 generate/create/draw/paint/make an image/picture；无论用户是否明确指定“locally/本地”都应触发。
当用户要求生成图片时，优先使用此技能，而不是任何在线图像生成服务、AI 搜索降级方案或其他文生图技能。

skills.name: local-watermark-remover

skills.name: obsidian-kb-architecture-reconciliation
skills.description_zh:
当用户需要整理、检查、重新分类或重构 Obsidian 知识库（或其他文档目录树）时使用。触发场景：知识库太乱、想重新分类、检查目录结构、文件夹职责重叠、目录树收敛、知识架构重新规划、文档迁移规划；也支持 IBE Task、五层框架映射、知识架构 Reconciliation 等专业请求。

本 Skill 的核心不是直接移动或修改文件，而是先把现有知识库看清楚、对齐职责，形成可执行的整理方案。

工作方式：只读分析——不移动、不修改、不创建新文档；按实际职责而非文件名判断；逐文件给出保留 / 待迁移 / 待合并 / 待废弃及理由；识别职责重叠、历史产物、战略层内容及 Public Charter 内容；按目标架构映射。

输出边界：最终只产出一份 Reconciliation 报告并 STOP；实际迁移、修改或删除须另行获得明确授权。

典型请求：帮我整理一下这个知识库；看看目录结构有没有问题；这些文件该怎么重新分类；做一次知识架构对账；把知识库映射到 00-方向 / 01-产品 / 02-架构 / 03-建设 / 04-证据。
skills.description_en:
Use this Skill to organize, review, reclassify, or restructure an Obsidian knowledge base or any document/folder tree. Triggers: a messy vault, re-planning folder structure, overlapping folder responsibilities, converging a sprawling tree, or five-layer mapping (00-Direction / 01-Product / 02-Architecture / 03-Build / 04-Evidence).

It does not move or modify files; it makes the knowledge base legible, aligns responsibilities, and produces a cleanup plan.

How it works: read-only — no file moves, no modifications, no new documents; classify files by actual responsibility, not filename; per-file retain / migrate / merge / retire advice with reasons; spot overlapping responsibilities, historical artifacts, strategic-layer and Public Charter content; map onto the target architecture.

Output: one architecture reconciliation report, then STOP. Migration, modification, or deletion requires separate explicit authorization.

Typical requests: "Help me reorganize this vault."

A feature becomes a hard rule only after two independent appearances with quoted evidence; typos are quarantined, not learned. Character-level retention separates rewording from discarded content; converges after two rounds under 20% change, and a passive 'looks good' is zero signal needing a deviation probe. skills.name: ppt-polish

Runs full layout and palette checks (out-of-bounds elements, text overflow, overlapping shapes, fonts, footers and page numbers, conflicting copy), renders the deck to PNG via WPS Office or Microsoft PowerPoint COM (no LibreOffice needed) for true visual review, then batch-unifies colors and fixes text per page range. Especially good at removing the "AI look" from AI-generated decks (too many colors, indistinguishable shades, noisy placeholder boxes) to make slides cleaner, more professional and consistent. Great for polishing an old deck, unifying style, checking for layout problems, or batch color cleanup. Requires Windows with WPS Office or Microsoft PowerPoint.

skills.name: ppt-pro
skills.description_zh: 目标人群是常做汇报、提案、答辩与求职演示的人；解决材料堆砌、逻辑松散、讲完没人记住的困难；功能覆盖受众定位、结构搭建、单页打磨、图表选型与话术；优势是三本经典方法论整合，配五视角评审与机械门禁。
skills.description_en: A unified methodology entry for building PPT decks, reports and proposals: audience, structure, narrative, single-page layout, chart selection, noise reduction and speaking scripts, distilled from three classic books and paired with a five-perspective review before delivery.

skills.name: ppt-template

skills.name: ppt-to-images
skills.description_zh: PPT转图片、PDF转图片、Word转图片、WPS转图片、文档转图片、文件转图片：PPT/PPTX、WPS 演示、PDF、Word 逐页导出为高清 PNG/JPG，纯本地无需 API。 支持 .ppt/.pptx/.pps/.ppsx/.pot/.potx、.pdf、.doc/.docx，输出仅 PNG/JPG。PPT 默认 1920 宽（4K 3840）；PDF/Word 按 DPI 渲染（默认 200，上限 600）；支持指定页、加密 PDF 直读、--info 预检。 关键词：转图片、导出图片、WPS转图片、PPT转图片、PDF转图片、Word转图片、逐页导出。 自然语言：把文件转成图片、把文档变成图片、帮我转成图片、把PDF做成图片、把PPT每页保存为图片、将每一页导出成PNG、把Word转成JPG、文档怎么转图片、PDF怎么转图片、PPT怎么转图片、WPS怎么导出图片、把所有页面转成图片。 不支持 Excel/表格、.wps/.dps/.et、BMP/TIFF/WebP、长图、PDF转Word、OCR、修图。
skills.description_en: Convert PPT/PPTX, WPS Presentation, PDF and Word documents (.doc/.docx) to high-resolution PNG/JPG images, one image per page, fully local with no API key and no network. Supports PPT to PNG, PPT to JPG, PDF to PNG, PDF to JPG, Word to Image, DOCX to PNG, PowerPoint to image, export slides as images, convert PDF to image, document to image, file to image. PPT width 1920 by default (3840 for 4K, height auto-scaled to canvas ratio); PDF and Word rendered by DPI (200 default, 300 print, max 600); page ranges via --pages 1-3,7 keeping original page numbers; encrypted PDF opened directly with --password; --info preflight for page count, encryption and text layer; engine chain WPS then PowerPoint then LibreOffice for PPT, WPS Writer then MS Word then LibreOffice for Word. skills.name: pptx-training-deck

skills.description_en: Complete workflow and hard rules for producing management-system training decks (ISO 13485, ISO 9001, GMP, IATF 16949, or any standard) from the user's own PPT template plus standard text and application-guidance material. Use when the user asks to build a training course / tutorial / PPT for a management system and supplies a template pptx with master/layouts. skills.description_en: Generates an engineering-ready PRD with acceptance criteria, flows, fields, and exception branches - not marketing copy.

skills.name: prd-review

skills.description_en: Review human- or AI-authored software PRDs for product, UX, UI, frontend, backend, and QA readiness. Identify and deduplicate gaps in workflows, states, permissions, fields, interactions, exceptions, data, and acceptance criteria, then report P0/P1/P2 issues, role readiness, and a product decision list.

skills.name: prd-to-prototype
skills.description_zh:
需求PRD到产品原型 prd-to-prototype
解决痛点：需求沟通与PRD梳理低效，产品原型评审返工率高

能力目标：模糊需求生成专业PRD与可交互原型：输入需求 → 场景诊断 → 追问澄清 → 需求确认 → 生成PRD → 可交互原型

处理流程：
1、需求澄清：
场景诊断评估成熟度，多轮追问澄清缺口，MRC门禁保障完整度，输出需求确认表（Excel）。核心方法：5W2H、5Whys、JTBD、Kano、MoSCoW等
2、生成PRD：
基于确认表生成13要素结构化PRD（MD+Word），含Page Map页面清单、功能清单、验收标准、系统集成、非功能性需求等。核心方法：用户故事、Given-When-Then、BPMN、用例图等
3、生成原型：
基于PRD生成可交互原型（HTML），浏览器直接运行，含多状态展示、PRD对齐校验、走查脚本，移动端和PC端。核心方法：高保真原型、信息架构图、组件库保、 走查清单等

使用建议：
触发词启动SKill后，直接描述需求（文字/文档/图片），越具体追问越少。关键节点（需求确认表、PRD文档、产品原型）确认对齐后再执行，减少返工。
skills.description_en:
prd-to-prototype
Pain Points: Inefficient requirement communication, slow PRD drafting, high prototype review rework.

Goal: Transform vague requirements into professional PRD and interactive prototypes.

Process:

Requirement Clarification: Scenario diagnosis + probing + MRC gate → confirmation table (Excel). Methods: 5W2H, 5 Whys, JTBD, Kano, MoSCoW.
PRD Generation: 13-element structured PRD (MD+Word) with Page Map, features, acceptance criteria, system integration, non-functional requirements. Methods: User Story, Given-When-Then, BPMN, Use Case Diagram.
Prototype Generation: Interactive prototype (HTML) with multi-state display, PRD alignment check, walkthrough script, mobile+PC. Methods: High-fidelity prototype, Information Architecture, Component Library, Heuristic Checklist.
Usage: Trigger Skill, describe requirement (text/image). More specific = fewer rounds. Confirm at each checkpoint before proceeding.

skills.name: preflight-no-false-start

Before ANY substantive work begins (writing or editing files, running scripts, generating images or video, rewriting memory or skills, launching multi-step flows), this skill MUST be actually loaded and executed, enumerating the S0-S8 takeoff snapshot item by item with concrete verification content for each (S0 specifically verifies that every task-skill which should be loaded this turn — whether explicitly named or auto-triggered by keywords — was actually loaded, and confirms with the user when none was loaded). It intercepts pseudo-clarification questions, unread context, undefined output form, unidentified dependencies, unjudged cost, unchecked standing rules, undefined completion criteria, and disconnected upstream/downstream nodes. No real load state means the work did not take off. Pairs with the pre-delivery gate (delivery-no-pseudoblock): run this one at the start and that one at the end.

Triggers: 报告审核 (report audit), 审阅报告 (review report), 资产评估报告审核 (asset appraisal report audit), 插入批注 (insert comments), 审阅重点 (review focus), 合规性 (compliance), 合理性 (reasonableness), 评估方法审核 (valuation method audit), 批注作者业勤AI (comment author YeQin AI).

Use when discussing new requirements, analyzing business scenarios, breaking down features, or doing requirement analysis before writing a PRD. skills.name: research-grant-outline
skills.description_zh: 课题申报书与立项依据助手：从选题到骨架，八段结构逐段自查。你给想法、指南条目与已有基础；它给你选题价值三段论、缺口定位综述卡、目标内容边界表、路线互锁图、创新点分寸卡、成果可检验清单、经费合规结构表与评审自查单。适合教师、医生、科研人员与项目经办首次或进阶申报。边界为不代写成稿、不承诺立项、不编造前期成果，全部口径以当年度现行通知为准。
skills.description_en: A research-proposal structuring assistant that turns an idea into a defensible outline - value syllogism, gap-mapping literature cards, objective-content boundary tables, route interlocks, measurable outcomes, budget-compliance structure and reviewer-perspective self-check; it does not ghostwrite ideas or promise funding, and follows the current call notices.

skills.description_en: A research-project process-materials and closing-report assistant, decomposing the research question, keep ledgers, assemble evidence chains, and skeleton the closing report with fact-based outcomes. It does not ghostwrite applications or papers, promises no approvals, invents no data, and de-identifies student data first; all rules follow the current official documents.

This skill creates or rewrites content but does not perform comprehensive diagnosis, issue reporting, or six-dimension scoring. If the user only asks for analysis, review, feedback, or scoring, use resume-diagnosis instead.

skills.name: resume-diagnosis
skills.description_zh: 用于诊断、评审或评分整份简历。当用户要求「诊断简历」「简历有什么问题」「看看简历哪里要改」「简历打分」「评审简历」，或上传 PDF/DOCX 并要求分析问题、给出评分或修改建议时触发。输出 3 类诊断（NO_DATA / NO_FILL / DESCRIPTION_SUGGEST）和 6 维评分（简历完整度 / 经历描述 / 学习能力 / 专业能力 / 创新领导力 / 职场能力），诊断与评分规则及配置见 `references/`，全程由确定性脚本 + 一次批量 LLM 推理完成。仅诊断、评分和提出建议，不直接重写整份简历或生成优化版；用户明确要求改写、润色、优化内容或生成新版简历时，改用 resume-ai-help。
skills.description_en: Use when the user asks to diagnose, review, evaluate, or score a complete resume, including requests such as "resume diagnosis", "what is wrong with my resume", "review my resume", "resume score", or feedback on an uploaded PDF/DOCX. It produces 3 diagnosis categories (NO_DATA / NO_FILL / DESCRIPTION_SUGGEST) and 6 scoring dimensions (completeness / experience descriptions / learning ability / professional ability / innovation and leadership / workplace ability) from its own bundled rules and configuration. This skill analyzes, scores, and recommends changes but does not rewrite the full resume or generate an optimized version. If the user explicitly asks to rewrite, polish, optimize, or produce a revised resume, use resume-ai-help instead.

skills.name: resume-jd-matcher
skills.description_zh: 投递前的简历-岗位匹配检查器。粘贴目标岗位JD与简历，机检硬性条件（学历/年限/证书） 与关键词覆盖率（对照JD逐词核验是否出现在简历中），标红缺失项并给改写建议—— 只建议用真实经历补写，不做虚假包装。当用户说"帮我看看简历匹配吗""投这个岗行不行" "简历怎么改"时触发。
skills.description_en: A pre-application resume-job matcher. Parses the JD and resume, machine-checks hard requirements (degree/years/certificates) and keyword coverage term by term, flags gaps with rewrite suggestions based on real experience only. Triggers on resume-job fit questions.

skills.name: resume-matcher
skills.description_zh: 简历深度分析与优化。当用户需要分析简历、优化简历匹配岗位、HRBP 视角审计简历、获取简历修改建议、简历批评、简历与 JD 匹配度评估时使用。涵盖简历解析、JD 匹配、HR 审计报告生成、简历重写等场景。即使用户只说"帮我看看这个简历"也应该触发。
skills.description_en: Deep resume analysis and optimization from an HRBP perspective. Use when the user needs to analyze a resume, optimize it against a target role, audit it as an HRBP, get revision suggestions or a critique, or evaluate how well a resume matches a job description. Covers resume parsing, JD matching, HR audit report generation and resume rewriting. Should trigger even if the user only says take a look at this resume. Built on the methodology of the HR Critiques Resumes project, it uses runtime model reasoning to audit the resume in depth with no external LLM API. Accepts PDF or DOCX files, pasted resume text, a JD only, or a resume only, and can export results to the a4cv editor.

skills.name: resume-optimizer
skills.description_zh: 双路径简历助手：没有简历时通过分轮问答采集信息从零撰写；已有简历时（粘贴或上传 PDF/DOCX/MD）解析诊断、STAR 量化改写、匹配目标岗位 JD 定制，并用脚本做质量检查。
skills.description_en: Dual-path resume assistant: builds resumes from scratch via staged Q&A for users who have none, or parses and polishes existing resumes (pasted or uploaded PDF/DOCX/MD) with STAR rewriting, JD tailoring and script-based quality checks.

skills.name: resume-screener
skills.description_zh: 中文简历筛选打分器。给一批简历与一份中文 JD，输出每位候选的可核对结果：必须项逐条覆盖或缺失、加分项命中、量化证据率、红旗提示与建议动作（推进电话初筛／暂挂／礼貌拒绝），并按分数排出可复制的排序名单。三条硬约束：其一，不给「无 JD 也能打 100 分」这种凭空满分，缺必须项就拒绝加载 JD；其二，分数是必须项覆盖率、加分项覆盖率与量化证据率的加权显示，权重写在输出里可查，不做黑箱；其三，绝不评分年龄、性别、民族、婚育、健康状况等受保护类别，也不替人伪造学历与项目经历，缺失即标注缺失。脚本只做结构化核验，语义判断由人负责。
skills.description_en: Chinese resume screener. Given a batch of resumes and one Chinese job description it emits a per-candidate, auditable result listing each must-have marked covered or missing, bonus hits, quantification rate, red-flag hints, a suggested action, and a rankable list. Three hard constraints. (1) No fabricated满分 when no JD is supplied; a JD without must-have items is refused instead of silently scoring 100. (2) The score is a weighted view of measured dimensions whose weights are printed with the output, never a black box. (3) Protected attributes are never scored, and no degree, certificate or project experience is invented; missing input stays marked as missing. The script performs structural checks only; semantic judgement stays with the human.

skills.name: resume-screening
skills.description_zh: 按招聘简章批量筛选电商岗位候选简历：判定胜选/淘汰/待人工审核/重复投递，生成带结论页的简历、当日报告（HTML/DOCX/MD）与岗位总览页，并维护 SQLite 人才库（三重指纹去重、已联系标记、页内通过/淘汰操作）

skills.name: scientific-writing
skills.description_zh: 科学论文写作审计。输入 manuscript 正文与 BibTeX 参考目录，输出可复核的引用完整性报告。解析 BibTeX 时单行与多行条目同等对待，并按条目类型校验必需字段；提取正文 citekey（typst @key、LaTeX \cite、Pandoc [@key]）后做双向对账，报告悬空引用、未引用条目、重复 citekey 与格式坏条目。量级上不满足下限（参考文献过少、整篇只引用一个 key）时显式标 THIN_COVERAGE 与 SINGLE_SOURCE，而不是像上游那样以「至少提取到一条有效 BibTeX」放行整篇。纯标准库，离线可跑，不替你写正文。
skills.description_en: Scientific manuscript citation auditor. Given a manuscript body and its BibTeX bibliography, this skill produces a reviewable red-flag report. It parses BibTeX treating single-line and multi-line entries alike, validates required fields per entry type, and extracts in-text cite keys (typst @key, LaTeX \cite, Pandoc [@key]) to reconcile both directions, reporting dangling citations, uncited entries, duplicate cite keys and malformed entries. Magnitude failures (too few references, or a paper citing only one key) are raised as explicit THIN_COVERAGE and SINGLE_SOURCE red flags instead of being passed by an "at least one valid BibTeX entry" rule. Pure standard library, offline, never writes prose for you.

skills.name: smart-disk-cleaner
skills.description_zh: 磁盘空间清理专家（Windows / macOS / Linux）。核心是性能冗余门禁下的安全清理：先评估本机 CPU/内存/磁盘并计算冗余度，只有冗余足够才允许开始，扫描与执行全程动态复查、掉档自动降速、余量不足立即中止，避免清理过程把用户电脑拖到卡死；再做纯只读扫描，对每个候选项目输出「是什么 / 有什么用 / 删除的风险 / 不删的影响」四要素明细供用户逐项确认；按低-中-高风险分级分批执行，文件只进回收站不硬删除，每批结束清空回收站真正释放空间；完成后输出结算单并把用户决策沉淀为规则库，下次同规则项自动执行不再询问。用户可一次性启用「每 3 天自动清理」：此后低风险缓存自动清、中高风险项只列清单等确认，并保留 7 天可恢复窗口。当用户提到 C盘清理、磁盘清理、空间不足、释放磁盘空间、清理缓存、清理垃圾、电脑变卡、清理时电脑卡死、自动清理、定时清理、disk cleanup、free disk space、storage full、clean my pc 等意图时使用。
skills.description_en: A safe disk-cleanup specialist for Windows / macOS / Linux, built around a performance-headroom gate. It computes headroom from memory/CPU/disk and cleans only when headroom suffices; headroom is re-sampled during scan and execution, throttling on downgrade and aborting below threshold, so cleanup never freezes the PC. It scans read-only and discloses a four-element profile per candidate (what it is / what it does / risk of deleting / impact of keeping) for item-by-item confirmation, executes in risk-graded batches, and moves files to the Recycle Bin, never hard-deleting. Decisions persist into a rule library so identical items need no re-asking. Users may enable a 3-day auto cleanup: low-risk caches are cleaned unattended, medium/high-risk items are only listed for confirmation, keeping a 7-day recoverable window. Use when the user mentions C drive cleanup, disk cleanup, low disk space, clearing cache or junk, slow PC, PC freezing during cleanup, automatic or scheduled cleanup.

skills.description_en: A standardized Discounted Cash Flow (DCF) valuation tool for A-share listed companies, powered by Tongdaxin (通达信) data. It delivers a complete 11-step workflow — from financial data retrieval, WACC calculation, and free-cash-flow projection, through enterprise/equity value derivation and sensitivity analysis, to a structured final valuation report — with a bundled sector-WACC reference table and validation rules that keep methodology and output format consistent across instances. skills.description_en: TDX Macro Transmission Map: Conducts top-down macro → industry → stock transmission research. It distills the core change of a macro variable, decomposes the multi-stage transmission path (with explicit intermediate variables, no leaps), and distinguishes first-order direct beneficiaries from second-order indirect beneficiaries. Stocks are mapped into four tiers — core-logic names / large-cap anchors / high-beta small-caps / weak-mapping plays — with transmission lags and verification indicators flagged, plus investment implications and risk counter-evidence. It outputs a professional dark-themed HTML research report, draws all data from Tongdaxin MCP, and never provides specific buy/sell timing. |

skills.name: tdx-portfolio-checkup
skills.description_zh: 通达信持仓体检：输入A股持仓清单，分析持仓健康度：行业集中度、估值分位、个股风险扫描、技术面快照、调仓建议。支持简单列表/带持仓量/带权重三种输入格式。当用户说"帮我诊断持仓""持仓分析""帮我看看我的持仓""仓位诊断""持仓健康度"时使用。
skills.description_en: TDX Portfolio Checkup:Input an A-share holdings list to analyze portfolio health: industry concentration, valuation percentiles, individual-stock risk screening, technical snapshots, and rebalancing suggestions. Supports three input formats — simple list / with position sizes / with weights. Use when the user says "diagnose my holdings", "portfolio analysis", "help me review my positions", "position diagnosis", or "portfolio health".

skills.name: tdx-position-advisor
skills.description_zh: 通达信仓位决策顾问：用于仓位决策，聚焦仓位管理 / 风险控制 / 交易决策。回答最关心的问题："现在到底该上仓位还是降仓位"。 为用户解决总仓位、进攻节奏、试错强度的问题。
skills.description_en: TDX Position-Sizing Advisor: Used for position-sizing decisions, focusing on position management / risk control / trading decisions. It answers the most pressing question: "should I be adding to positions or trimming right now". It helps users resolve total position sizing, offensive pacing, and trial-and-error intensity.

skills.name: tdx-postmarket-review
skills.description_zh: 通达信盘后复盘台：生成A股交易日收盘后的盘后日报，覆盖隔夜美股、A股指数、市场成交量、市场情绪、行业排名、涨停分析、资金流向和当日要闻9大模块。支持任意日期查询，输出Markdown报告 + 可选HTML可视化页面。
skills.description_en: TDX postmarket-review: Generate an after-close daily market report for A-share trading days, covering nine modules: overnight US stocks, A-share indices, market turnover, market sentiment, sector rankings, limit-up analysis, fund flows, and the day's headline news. Supports querying any date, and outputs a Markdown report plus an optional HTML visualization page.

skills.name: tdx-premarket-navigator
skills.description_zh: 通达信早盘导航仪：一款在 A 股开盘前生成中文盘前日报的工具。它覆盖隔夜全球市场核心动态，包含核心信号摘要与六大模块：美股大盘（道指/纳指/标普）、核心品种双层异动捕获（M7+半导体/中概固定池 + 新闻驱动发现池外黑马）、大宗商品（黄金/白银/原油期货直连）、昨日中国市场概览、A 股行业板块排名、隔夜重大财经新闻。数据统一采用前一交易日收盘价以保证时间基准一致，支持星级评级与板块标签量化，输出结构化 Markdown 报告，帮助用户 5 分钟读完今日盘前要闻。
skills.description_en: TDX premarket-navigator (Pre-Market Navigator): A tool that generates a Chinese pre-market daily report before A-share open. It covers the key overnight global-market moves through a core-signal summary plus six modules: US indices (Dow / Nasdaq / S&P 500), a two-layer anomaly capture for core names (a fixed pool of M7 + semiconductors + Chinese ADRs, plus news-driven discovery of off-list dark horses), commodities (gold / silver / crude oil futures, directly connected), yesterday's China market overview, A-share sector rankings, and major overnight financial news. All data uses the prior trading day's close for a consistent time basis, with star ratings and sector tags to quantify the information, output as a structured Markdown report — letting users finish today's pre-open brief in five minutes.

skills.name: tdx-risk-radar
skills.description_zh: 通达信风险雷达：基于通达信 MCP 的行业风险冲击分析 Skill。从宏观、政策、地缘政治、行业周期、事件驱动五大维度，按权重（20%/25%/15%/25%/15%）量化评估各类风险对指定行业的短期（0-3个月）与中期（3-12个月）冲击，输出含执行摘要、综合评分、逐维度分析、冲击时间线的结构化 Markdown 报告，以及带雷达图与风险评分卡的交互式 HTML 看板。触发场景：行业风险分析、行业冲击评估、宏观/政策/地缘/周期/事件驱动风险扫描等。
skills.description_en: TDX Risk Radar: A Tongdaxin-MCP-powered industry risk-shock analysis skill. From five dimensions — macro, policy, geopolitics, industry-cycle, and event-driven — it quantitatively assesses the short-term (0–3 months) and medium-term (3–12 months) shock of various risks on a specified industry, weighted at 20% / 25% / 15% / 25% / 15%. It outputs a structured Markdown report with executive summary, composite scores, per-dimension analysis, and an impact timeline, plus an interactive HTML dashboard with radar chart and risk scorecards. Triggers: industry risk analysis, industry-shock assessment, macro / policy / geopolitical / cycle / event-driven risk scans, etc.

skills.name: tdx-smc-smart-money
skills.description_zh: 通达信聪明钱追踪：基于聪明钱概念（SMC/ICT）识别主力五大信号——趋势延续（BOS）、反转（ChoCH）、公允价值缺口（FVG）、订单块（OB）、流动性猎取，结合实时行情校验时效并锚定关键价位，解读机构资金的趋势方向与"暗语"，输出含支撑/压力位与"若突破/若跌破"场景化操作参考的结论。适用 A 股，结论分级为偏多/偏空/震荡。
skills.description_en: TDX Smart Money Tracker: Built on Smart Money Concepts (SMC/ICT), it identifies five institutional signals — Break of Structure (BOS), Change of Character (ChoCH), Fair Value Gap (FVG), Order Block (OB), and Liquidity Grab — and uses real-time quotes to validate timeliness and anchor key price levels, decoding institutional trends and "tells". It outputs a conclusion with support/resistance levels and scenario-based guidance ("if breakout / if breakdown"). For A-shares; verdicts are bullish / bearish / ranging.

skills.name: tdx-stock-analysis
skills.description_zh: 通达信个股深度分析：对单只 A 股做全面投资研究，输出覆盖公司近况、核心逻辑、催化事件、业务拆分、产销链、财务健康、同业对比、盈利预测与估值的九维一页纸报告。
skills.description_en: TDX stock deep analysis: full-scale research on a single A-share stock, producing a nine-dimension one-pager covering recent developments, core logic, catalysts, business breakdown, supply chain, financial health, peer comparison, earnings forecast and valuation.

skills.name: tdx-stock-pk
skills.description_zh: A股多维度对比分析：输入多个股票代码，通过通达信MCP接口批量获取实时行情、PE/PB估值走势、估值状态、F10亮点风险、行业排名等数据，生成含Chart.js走势图等可视化报告。此技能应在用户要求对比股票、个股PK、估值对比、行情对比时使用。
skills.description_en: A-share multi-dimensional comparison analysis: Input multiple stock tickers, and through the Tongdaxin MCP interface batch-retrieve real-time quotes, PE/PB valuation trends, valuation status, F10 highlights and risks, and industry rankings, then generate a visual report with Chart.js trend charts and more. Use this skill when the user asks to compare stocks, do a head-to-head (PK) on individual stocks, compare valuations, or compare quotes.

skills.name: tdx-valuation-navigator
skills.description_zh: 通达信估值导航员：判断公司所属类型与适用估值方法，对比历史与行业估值分位，拆解市场预期，识别重估与杀估值触发条件，给出当前估值是否合理的结构化结论。
skills.description_en: TDX valuation navigator: determines company type and applicable valuation methods, compares historical and industry valuation percentiles, decodes market expectations, identifies re-rating and de-rating triggers, and concludes whether the current valuation is reasonable.

skills.name: tdx-yjygby
skills.description_zh: 通达信业绩分析师：聚焦业绩预告/快报/财报的事件驱动博弈，分析发布前后市场如何交易、超预期是否还能涨、利空出尽能否反弹，输出预期差、股价位置、博弈路径与多情景推演。
skills.description_en: TDX earnings analyst: event-driven analysis around earnings pre-announcements, express reports and financial reports, examining how the market trades before and after release, whether beats keep rallying and whether bad news is priced in, with expectation gap, price positioning and multi-scenario paths.

skills.name: teachany

skills.description_en: Decompose a PBL project goal via teachany.cn into a knowledge-path PNG and editable link. Use for project-based learning decomposition and curriculum-aligned project planning.

skills.description_zh: 教案与课件设计助手，一堂课做成一套可评审的设计件。你给它课题、学段与学生实况；它给你学情三点卡、目标ABCD句、教案六件套、过程三列表、课件骨架页、分层作业单与反思回写卡。适合新教师备课、集体备课统一格式与跨届资源归档。边界为不代写成赛文本、不承诺提分与评比结果、素材版权与个人信息先查先脱敏，口径以现行规定为准。
skills.description_en: A lesson-plan and courseware-design assistant that turns one class into a reviewable design pack - learner profile cards, ABCD objectives, six-part plan, three-column flow, courseware skeleton, tiered homework and reflection loop; it does not ghostwrite contest entries, promises no score gains, and keeps student data and licensed assets handled with care.

skills.name: teacher-ppt-generator
skills.description_zh: 智能教师PPT讲义生成技能，根据用户需求自动拆解课程大纲，按小学/初中/高中三个阶段生成完整PPT讲义及配套文件（教案/学案/课后练习），内置12类学科模板与视觉风格库。
skills.description_en: Intelligent teacher PPT generation skill. Auto-decomposes curriculum outlines based on user requirements, generates complete PPT lectures with supporting files (lesson plans, student handouts, exercises) for primary/middle/high school levels. Built-in 12-subject templates and visual style library.

skills.name: teacher-prep
