skills.description_en: One-pass lesson prep for primary Chinese lessons: lesson plan + courseware outline + practice exercises.

skills.name: teacher-workbench
skills.description_zh: 教师日常工作全流程赋能 Skill，覆盖中小学各科教师的教案撰写、教学设计、课件美化、教学成绩分析与班主任助理工作，以及教学计划、教学总结、说课稿、评课记录、公开课设计、述职报告、教研记录、课题材料等各项教师工作文本。用户请求上述任一教师工作任务时使用。
skills.description_en: A full-workflow empowerment skill for teachers of all subjects in primary and secondary schools, covering lesson plan writing, instructional design, courseware/PPT polishing, exam grade analysis, and class teacher assistance, plus teaching plans, summaries, lesson-presentation scripts, lesson evaluation, open-class design, work reports, teaching-research records, and project application materials. Use when the user requests any of these teacher work tasks.

skills.name: teaching-animation
skills.description_zh: 把抽象、难懂的知识点用「具象类比」转成动画：三种形式按需切换——对话内 SVG/HTML 交互动画（默认、免费秒出）、视频动画 MP4、动画脚本/分镜稿。覆盖数学、物理、化学、生物、语文、历史、地理、政治全学科。
skills.description_en: Turn abstract, hard-to-grasp knowledge points into intuitive animations via concrete analogies. Three on-demand output forms: in-chat SVG/HTML interactive animation (default, instant & free), MP4 video animation, and storyboard/script. Covers all primary and secondary school subjects.

skills.name: teaching-courseware-design
skills.description_zh: 教学课件全流程设计指导助手，兼顾逻辑、互动与视觉。覆盖新授课/复习课/探究课，支持希沃白板与 PPT，输出页面级设计脚本与具体操作路径。
skills.description_en: A full-process courseware design guide balancing logic, interaction, and visuals. Covers new/review/inquiry lessons, supports Seewo Whiteboard and PPT, and produces page-level design scripts with concrete operation paths.

skills.name: teaching-courseware-ppt-generator
skills.description_zh: 复刻「未来之城可动模块」课件生成流程的教学课件文案生成器，把零散教学素材整理为结构清晰、节奏合理、可直接登上投影的课堂课件。导入→精讲→动手→收束四段式骨架，每页用「第N页」固定标记格式输出要点短句，配套随堂测验10道穿插、动手三页组（步骤+检查清单+故障排查）、章节过渡页与首尾呼应的金句。仅在教学课件场景激活，方案/汇报/提案类任务全部规则立即失效。
skills.description_en: A teaching-courseware scriptwriter that replicates the workflow used to build the Future City movable-module lesson. It turns scattered teaching material into a clean, well-paced classroom script ready for projection. Produces a 4-stage skeleton (Hook → Deep dive → Hands-on → Close), emits every page in a fixed 「Page N」 marker format with short bullet points, embeds 10+ in-class quiz questions that follow the content, ships a hands-on trio (steps / checklist / troubleshooting), and uses chapter transition pages plus a recurring anchor phrase. Activates only for teaching-courseware tasks; for proposal, pitch or business-report decks the skill is fully disabled and default agent behavior applies.

skills.name: teaching-design-studio
skills.description_zh: 结构化教学设计与教案撰写，以及对已有教学设计的证据化诊断与优化。触发词：写教案、做教学设计、备课、说课设计、公开课设计、单元整体设计、诊断教案、教学设计体检、对标精品课、对标课标、布鲁姆目标层次、目标—教学—评价一致性、改教案。能力：① 从零产出含教学目标（ABCD 法 + 布鲁姆层次）、重难点、教学方法、时间轴教学过程、师生活动与提问链、学习支架、评价量规、分层作业、预习拓展的完整方案，参数缺失时按默认假设（45 分钟、学情中等、常规多媒体教室）补齐并声明；② 五维体检（课标对标、精品课规格、AI 应用、教学技能、五育呈现）加十项量规证据化评分，输出诊断报告与 P0/P1/P2 优先级、落到环节与分钟的优化建议，可出带痕迹的修订稿；③ 布鲁姆层次与三向一致性分析。覆盖中小学至高校各学科。不适用：出题组卷、PPT 美化、成绩统计、视频剪辑；工科教创赛材料与四维实践考核量表改用 teaching-design-craft。
skills.description_en: Instructional design and lesson-plan authoring, plus evidence-based diagnosis of existing teaching designs. Triggers: write a lesson plan, prepare a class, diagnose a teaching design, benchmark against exemplary-course standards, Bloom taxonomy, alignment check. Capabilities: (1) produce classroom-ready designs - measurable objectives (ABCD + Bloom levels), key points, methods, timed process timeline, teacher-student activities, assessment rubrics; missing inputs use declared defaults (45 min, mid-level learners, standard classroom); (2) five-dimension health check (standards alignment, exemplary-course specs, AI use, teaching skills, five-education integration) scored on a ten-item rubric with evidence, plus P0/P1/P2 improvements pinned to segments and minute marks; (3) Bloom-level and alignment analysis. Primary to higher education. Not for test generation, PPT styling or grade statistics; for engineering competition materials use teaching-design-craft.

skills.name: teaching-multi-analysis
skills.description_zh: 教学设计多维度分析指导助手。教师上传教学设计做五维体检（课标对标/精品课规格/AI应用/教学技能/五育呈现）或只给课名引导课堂创新，依据2022课标、2026精品课、教师AI案例指引等政策文件，建议落到环节/时间/师生活动。
skills.description_en: A multi-dimensional teaching design analysis assistant. Helps teachers upload teaching plans for a five-dimension health check (curriculum alignment / premium course standards / AI application / teaching skills / five-education outcomes), or provide a lesson title for guided classroom innovation, based on 2022 curriculum standards, 2026 premium course criteria, and teacher AI case guidelines. All suggestions are grounded in specific phases, time allocations, and teacher-student activities.

skills.name: teaching-plan-generator
skills.description_zh:
面向高职院校的教案（教学设计）自动生成器，覆盖高职、职业本科、应用型本科等学段。

模板自适应：当用户提供本校教案模板时，先解析其表格结构、字段标签与版式参数，以用户模板为唯一基准；未提供模板时，回退到内置通用教案结构（6 表模型）与通用写作规范。

触发词：生成教案、制作教案、编制教案、教案诊断、批量教案。

内置模板结构探测器与通用生成引擎（按字段映射表驱动，非硬编码坐标），支持干跑校验、单课次试生成与批量生成。写作要点内置课程思政自然融入、新技术应用、模块差异化教学策略等通用规范。
skills.description_en:
A university-agnostic lesson plan generator for Chinese higher vocational colleges, covering higher vocational, vocational undergraduate, and applied undergraduate levels.

Template-adaptive: when the user supplies their own lesson-plan template, the skill parses its table structure, field labels, and formatting, then treats that template as the sole authoritative baseline. Without a template, it falls back to a built-in generic 6-table structure.

Triggers on requests to generate, draft, or revise lesson plans, plus batch generation and legacy-plan diagnosis.

Ships a template-structure inspector and a docx-filling engine driven by a field-mapping file, with dry-run validation and batch output.

Safeguards: verbatim field labels, mandatory dry-run, and explicit labeling of generic-fallback content.

skills.name: teaching-ppt-generator
skills.description_zh:
高职院校授课课件（PPT）自动生成器。根据教师提供的教案、能力图谱、课程标准等材料，编排 ppt-master 工作流生成可直接上课用的 16:9 PPTX。

材料自适应：教案可来自任意院校格式（不假设固定模板），能力图谱从 HTML 的 treeData 动态提取工作领域与能力点，课程主色按课程名关键词自动推导。

内置八项设计确认、SVG 逐页生成、演讲备注拆分、动画分组、质检清单，支持单课次试生成与批量生成。

融合互动教学（钩子/投票/讨论）、AI 赋能页、思政潜移默化（绝不出现"思政"二字）、能力图谱关联等理念，能力图谱页按领域数量动态布局。
skills.description_en:
A teaching slide (PPT) generator for Chinese higher vocational colleges that turns lesson plans, ability maps, and course standards into classroom-ready 16:9 PPTX files by orchestrating the ppt-master workflow.

Input-adaptive: lesson plans may come from any institution's format (no fixed template assumed); ability maps are parsed dynamically from the HTML treeData; the course accent color is derived from the course name.

Ships an eight-point design confirmation, per-page SVG generation, speaker-note splitting, animation grouping, and a quality checklist, supporting both single-lesson trials and batch generation.

Blends interactive teaching (hooks, polls, discussion), AI-empowered pages, subtle ideological grounding without showing the literal term, and an ability-map page whose domain grid adapts to the actual number of domains.

skills.description_en: Write, rewrite, proofread, and review Chinese technical documentation, product and interface copy, API documentation, and operational guides. Improve clarity and typography while preserving facts, constraints, and machine-readable content.

skills.description_en: Tencent Cloud competitive analysis. Supports feature comparison, spec/performance benchmarking, pricing/billing benchmarking, and gap attribution between Tencent Cloud and rivals including Alibaba Cloud, Huawei Cloud, Volcano Engine, Baidu AI Cloud, AWS, and Azure. Built on dual-channel retrieval (Yunzhi/Lexiang + competitor official sites), relies solely on first-party official sources.

For image edits, it spells out what to change and what to preserve. From a quick concept to a cast of characters and locations for a story, give your ideas a clearer visual direction. Built for subject teachers, course editors, knowledge authors, and curriculum teams.

skills.name: windows-cleanup
skills.description_zh: Windows 电脑安全清理技能。六阶段闭环，先做可信空间量测拿到真实体积基线，再只读审计列清单，出分类计划，签发一次性令牌授权，分阶段执行，最后终态核验并输出自包含 HTML 报告。内置红线白名单，驱动、安全软件、系统更新、硬件必需组件、工作生产软件一律不动；所有文件删除统一走安全网关，永久删除模式永久禁用，注册表改动先备份可回退。新增 L1.5 系统级大户分类，WinSxS 与 WindowsApps 走 DISM 和 Appx 专用工具，实测体积与安全可清上限分开报告；新增 AI 工具数据识别，按归属目录而非扩展名识别，按重建成本分档。只处理 Windows 本机，全程本地执行，不联网、不上传任何数据。触发词：清理电脑、电脑卡、电脑慢、C盘满了、清 C 盘、释放磁盘空间、卸载软件、卸载预装、开机自启、启动项、临时文件、广告推荐、弹窗广告、注册表清理、磁盘清理、查C盘空间、看看什么占空间。

All file deletions go through a single safety gateway where permanent deletion is permanently disabled, and every registry change is backed up first and stays reversible. It also classifies system hotspots such as WinSxS and WindowsApps, which are handled only through DISM and Appx tooling with measured size and safe-reclaimable ceiling reported separately, and recognises AI tool caches by ownership directory instead of file extension, tiered by rebuild cost. Windows only, fully local, no network calls and nothing is uploaded.

connectors.description_en: Turn every idea into a striking image or video. Kling AI (Kling / 可灵AI) is an AI image generation and AI video generation connector for creators, designers, video producers, ecommerce sellers, advertising, marketing, and brand teams. In WorkBuddy, use natural language for text-to-image, image-to-image, text-to-video, image-to-video, reference-image creation, and single- or multi-shot video. Create posters, illustrations, portraits, product images, ecommerce hero images, Listing images, product detail graphics, ad creatives, product showcase videos, marketing clips, ecommerce short videos, social media videos, and cinematic content for Taobao, Tmall, JD, Pinduoduo, Douyin, Kuaishou, Xiaohongshu, TikTok, Amazon, Shopify, and more. Browse the subject library (Elements), view subject details, and create, update, delete, or reuse subjects. Browse and preview the motion library, then apply a saved motion or reference video to a subject image for motion-controlled video generation. Upload reference images, check remaining credits, submit generation tasks, track progress, query task status, and retrieve final images or videos. If you are searching for competitor tools, similar AI generators, or alternatives to Hailuo AI, Seedance (Seeddance), Vidu, Jimeng, Runway, Pika, Sora, or Veo, use Kling AI to build a high-quality Kling MCP creative workflow.

connectors.description_en: QCC Legal is a Chinese legal-data connector for searching, researching, and verifying statutes and judicial cases. On the regulation side it covers the full body of in-force Chinese law — laws, administrative regulations, departmental rules, judicial interpretations, and local regulations — at both the whole-regulation and individual-article level, returning verbatim text tagged with validity status (in force / amended / repealed), legal hierarchy, and promulgating authority, with common-name normalization (e.g. the Civil Code, the Personal Information Protection Law). On the case side it covers a massive corpus of ordinary judgment documents plus 25,000+ authoritative cases — Supreme People's Court and Supreme People's Procuratorate guiding cases, gazette cases, typical cases, and reference cases — filterable by cause of action, court, instance, judgment date, and party. It further verifies legal citations: given any text it detects every statute and case-number reference, checks each against the database, flags validity status, returns the authoritative source and verbatim text, and generates traceable hyperlinks — eliminating fabricated statutes and case numbers in AI-generated legal content. Use natural language to find statutory grounds, run legal research and analysis, retrieve similar cases, pull verbatim originals, and verify citations before delivery.
